Rulebook 21.2's rank numbers (F1: mob 5 / elite 60 / boss 125 / super 300) are a PART BUDGET summed across the Enemy model's bodyParts[], not a pooled HP bar - 7.3 resolves damage per part and 7.5 kills on head/torso at 0. Mobs are statted as ONE part at the mob number; a mob that survives a hit gets a GATE, never a fatter number. The Incineradile's 'single HP bar (total 50)' is a pre-doctrine tutorial exception. Proposed in rulebook/f1-enemy-pass.md E-0.1/E-0.2; UNBLESSED as of 2026-08-18.

The dev container has no MongoDB and cannot get one: the agent proxy returns 403 CONNECT for fastdl.mongodb.org, so mongodb-memory-server cannot download a binary either. Any seeder's DB path is therefore UNVERIFIABLE here - verify content/pure logic instead (seed-enemies.js splits its doctrine gate behind --check with lazy mongoose requires so it runs on a bare checkout), and say plainly that the DB path was not exercised.

server/seed-enemies.js adds a pattern the item/affix seeders lack: a content-doctrine gate that runs BEFORE any DB connection and exits 1 on violation (wrong part budget for the rank, a multi-part mob, a non-mob with no weak-system notes, an unknown tier), with --floor N rescaling it along the x2-per-floor ladder. --check runs the gate alone with no node_modules and no DB. Worth copying into seed-items/seed-affixes if their content ever grows rules worth enforcing.
